dissonance: The gear icon next to the avatar, and the 'Settings' modal it opens for editing a nickname, disappear — the player's saved nickname stops showing next to their avatar, in the Recent Games panel, and in the high-score list, reverting to their Google display name/email or a plain 'Player' label.

metric.name: nickname_set
metric.description: Counts how many signed-in sessions result in the player saving a nickname, divided by total signed-in logins.
